description: This file defines classes and logic for displaying tool information in an Android app, including configuration parsing, summary generation, and utility functions for tool detail extraction.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Serializable data class for specifying actions related to tools, including optional label and detail keys.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing the specification for a tool's display properties, including emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Serializable container for the overall tool display configuration, including version, fallback spec, and map of tools.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: Data class representing a summarized view of a tool, including name, emoji, title, label, optional verb, and detail string. Contains computed properties for display formatting.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object managing loading, caching, and resolving tool display specifications into summaries based on context and input arguments.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Primary method to resolve and generate a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, tool name, arguments, and optional metadata.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Load and parse the JSON configuration for tool display, with caching.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generate a user-friendly title from the tool's name.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalize verb strings by trimming and replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Generate detail string specific to 'read' actions based on arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieve the first non-blank rendered value from a list of keys in JSON arguments.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Navigate JSON object structure to retrieve value at dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Render JSON values into displayable string summaries, handling primitive types and arrays.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replace home directory paths with tilde notation for cleaner display.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely extract string from JsonElement.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely extract number from JsonElement.
